configuration.title: Session Sync for Claude Code
config.mode.description: How sessions travel between devices. Use **Claude Sync: Choose sync method** to change it.
config.mode.enum1: Sign in with GitHub; a private claude-sessions repository is created automatically.
config.mode.enum2: Dropbox, signed in directly in the browser (no Dropbox app needed).
config.mode.enum3: OneDrive, signed in directly in the browser (no OneDrive app needed).
config.mode.enum4: Google Drive, signed in directly in the browser (no Google Drive app needed).
config.mode.enum5: A folder kept in sync by a storage's own app: iCloud Drive, Google Drive, MEGA, pCloud, Box, Proton Drive, Nextcloud…
config.syncFolder.description: Cloud-storage method: the folder that holds the sessions. Filled in when you pick a storage on first use; you can also set any synced folder by hand.
config.deviceName.description: Name of this device in the storage: its sessions are exported to their own folder under this name, and other devices choose it when importing. Empty = the computer's host name.
config.repoUrl.description: Own-git method: URL of a **private** git repository that stores the transcripts (`https://…`, `ssh://…` or `git@host:owner/repo.git`).
config.maxFileSizeMB.description: Sessions bigger than this are **not pushed** (and are reported). GitHub rejects any file over 100 MB, and one such file fails the whole push.
config.maxSessionAgeDays.description: Push only sessions modified within this many days. `0` = no limit. A pull always takes everything the repository holds.
config.scanSecrets.description: Before a push, look for API keys, tokens and private keys in the sessions about to be sent, and ask whether to leave those sessions out.
config.projectKey.description: The same value on every device matches a project that has no git remote (or different remotes). Empty = the git remote, otherwise the folder name.
